optimizedContext.value:
# ESLint Rules

## Rules
- Reject explicit `any`; use `unknown` + guards
- Reject default exports
- Exported functions/methods: explicit return types
- `src/` files: kebab-case naming
- JSDoc on all functions, methods, classes, types, interfaces: description, `@param`, `@returns`, `@throws`
- Layer boundaries via `no-restricted-imports`: domain/ → no application/infrastructure/composition; application/ → no infrastructure/composition; infrastructure/ → no composition

## Constraints
- Type-aware rules for all `.ts`
- Lint errors fixed before commit (lint-staged pre-commit)
- `test/**/*.spec.ts` exempt from JSDoc
- `dist/`, `node_modules/` excluded
